description: Source file implementing system path retrieval functions for Windows, including executable path, content directory, cache directory, and temporary directory.

methods.name: GetExecutablePath
methods.description: Retrieves the full path of the current executable, ensuring it fits within the provided buffer.

methods.name: GetExecutableDirectory
methods.description: Retrieves the directory containing the current executable.

methods.name: GetRelativeDirectory
methods.description: Builds a path relative to the executable directory.

methods.name: GetContentPath
methods.description: Gets the path to the content data directory.

methods.name: GetCachePath
methods.description: Gets the path to the cache directory.

methods.name: CreateAndGetTempPath
methods.description: Creates and retrieves a temporary directory path.

methods.name: SbSystemGetPath
methods.description: Main function to get various system paths based on path ID.
